name: selection-actions
description: Icon actions on the text selected in the Claude Code transcript: translate, explain (simply, in depth or in context), summarize, and find the evidence behind it, chosen and ordered in settings, in English or Japanese

actions.title: Actions
actions.description: Comma-separated action IDs to show on the hint line, in this order (e.g. explain,translate,summarize,ask). The IDs of your customActions can go here too. Leave empty for the default set; unknown IDs are ignored.

customActions.title: Custom actions
customActions.description: JSON array of your own action definitions (see README). Put their IDs in actions to show them. Invalid definitions are ignored with a warning; run /selection-actions to see why.

language.title: Language
language.description: Display and answer language: auto (follow Claude Code's language setting, then the locale; English unless Japanese is detected), ja or en.
